svg.title: Local participation in a multi-space server
svg.desc: Local rooms remain in SQLite. Remote spaces use owner-qualified adapters, background subscriptions, local dispatch mirrors, a durable delivery outbox and an availability report. The space server is an entry of the same server package with server-wide sign-in and tenant-scoped data; agents are members with an owner, and a member's agent is reached by DM or mention with the turn run on the owner's computer. Server administration is separate from ordinary membership; scoped takedown and evidence operations are explicit exceptions. Installation grants own their enrolled agents. Authoritative removal purges local mirrors; unknown errors do not.
